brief: Holds two values side by side and tells whether both are numbers, texts, lists or objects.
detail: Build one with new stzPair([ a, b ]) or StzPairQ([ a, b ]); the global IsPair(aList) tells whether a plain list has exactly two items. Item1 and Item2 read the two sides, and it is a stzList, so every list method also works. The list given to init is not checked for holding two items. Update, UpdateWith, Swap and Swapped raise error R24 today, so a pair cannot be changed or swapped through them.
